components.provenance: Bounded sparse discovery wrapper around existing Living searchWorlds and enterKey APIs. It caps rows/pages, yields between browser pages for real cancellation, rejects stale cross-system results, preserves continuation cursors and never enumerates the universe or directly mutates canonical selection.

Living-native current-location, breadcrumb, selection, debounced announcement, focus recovery and progressive bounded-discovery UI. Discovery remains hidden until a stellar-system context exists, preserving viewport-first layout; running discovery renders busy/cancel state immediately; result travel delegates to Living enterKey only.

Lane-owned skip-link, current-context and discovery presentation, compact safe-area, 44px+ critical targets, explicit focus-visible and scoped reduced-motion styling. No product truth or input authority.
